name: The Rime Caves
about: Ice caverns under Stonehollow's cliff: bioluminescent ice pools, glowing icicle-pillars with frost runes, Rimewife Solvi's rune-hall in the north-west, and at the north end the Barrow mouth: a 6 m stone door with three rune locks on a raised step. A frozen waterfall hides a spring in the north-east.

exits.label: the cave path back to Stonehollow

actors.name: Rimewife Solvi
say: Cold fire is a gift. It lights. It never burns.

actors.name: Skuli
say: Goats know the way round the side.
